newsitem.title: UK: Manchester United shares set new high.
newsitem.headline: Manchester United shares set new high.

text.p: Shares in Manchester United Plc set a new record high on Tuesday amid continued investment demand in the premiership soccer club following news that the company will join the FTSE 250 index, traders said.
"As it is joining the 250 some funds are having to buy into the stock," said one market maker.
The stock was up 18-1/2p at 602-1/2 by 1512 GMT in modest volume of 534,808 shares, after earlier rising as high as 605p -- surpassing the previous record of 594p set October 14.
Changes to the membership of the UK stock indexes, announced on December 11, take effect on December 23.
